results.title: Santa Barbara Man Among Americans In Russian Captivity As Ukraine War Rages
results.description: WASHINGTON D.C. (KEYT) – Last week, local Congressman Salud Carbajal met with the family of Aleksandr Antonov, a 66-year-old Santa Barbara man imprisoned in Russia since March of 2025. "My family and I are so grateful to Rep. Carbajal for his proactive leadership in advocating for my father's freedom," Anastasia Antonova, Mr. Antonov's daughter, shared. The post Santa Barbara Man Among Americans In Russian Captivity As Ukraine War Rages appeared first on News Channel 3-12.

results.title: The Cast of Superstore: What Are They Doing Now?
results.description: While it might not have swept up an endless mantle of Emmy awards during its six-season run, Superstore did something much rarer: it captured the hearts of millions. The comedy series was the perfect blend of hilarious, soulful, and surprisingly dramatic – and if you ask any retail worker, it was almost terrifyingly true to life. Cloud 9 didn’t just hit us with unforgettable gags; it gave us real, grounded characters whose high stakes made us lean right in.
